description: Parkings gratuits sur Vaux le Pénil is a dataset listed in data.melunvaldeseine.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Commune de Vaux le Penil. Localisation des parkings publics gratuits sur la commune de Vaux le Pénil. Coverage: Melun Val de Seine (Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Territoire, équipements, services, Mobilités. Its keywords are stationnement, voitures. The portal shows 9 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melunvaldeseine-fr-portal.
